# Updater signature fixtures

Generated for ImgConvert under Apache-2.0 with an ephemeral test-only Tauri
signing key. Only the public key, signatures and synthetic payloads are kept.
The payloads contain an ELF/AppImage-shaped header but are **not executable
packages**. They test signature compatibility, corruption rejection and atomic
replacement; they do not prove installation of a cargo-packager AppImage.
